verdict.rationale: Mesh screens customers against sanctions, watchlists, PEP registers and adverse media in one API, with synchronous screening for real-time onboarding. Results arrive via a WORKFLOW_COMPLETED webhook, and alerts are reviewed and decided in a single case-management surface (web app or API). The evidence never shows ComplyAdvantage doing the identity verification itself, so 'part of the same verification' depends on an external IDV step. missing for 10: native identity verification bundled into the same flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of screening quality.
